subject: Error when observe update relies on function with validate block

messages.author: b36c2576e2f48cf9
messages.subject: Error when observe update relies on function with validate block
parts:
This took a long time to figure out and I haven't found a way to fix it:

If I have an observer that updates the choices available in an input selector based on a reactive function, and that reactive
function has a validate/need block to check for its inputs, then the app crashes and dumps the validate message to the console.
What I would expect to happen is that the observer ignores validate errors, or at the very least replaced the element with the
error message so I knew where the problem happened.

I have not been able to find way to check if a reactive function has returned a validate message and thus prevent the observe
from trying to access the updated value until it has an actual value to work with. Is there a way to get this to work?

I will get you a minimal example just as soon as I sort out the webserver's websocket issue.
